title: An onboarding action, end to end

steps.title: The operation
steps.body: An internal IT onboarding action creates a request and returns a request ID plus link.

steps.title: Why custom
steps.body: The target is an internal system with validation before the write, which built-in actions do not cover.

steps.title: Where it runs
steps.body: Added as a step in Agent Builder, with inputs supplied as fixed values, user inputs, or AI-predicted values.

steps.title: What it composes with
steps.body: It can sit in the same workflow as By Glean and By datasource actions.
